risks.note: The BRSR material-issues table flags cheap imports from China and ASEAN as putting pressure on domestic prices and margins, with negative financial implication. The Board's Report independently describes the year as marked by continued import pressure from low-cost origins and subdued realisations across certain product segments, and turnover was marginally lower on net sales realisation pressure. Mitigation is quality differentiation, focus on specification-driven customers and pursuit of trade-remedy support through industry associations.

This is the structural exposure of a non-integrated mill. Pulp, wastepaper, chemicals and packaging inputs are exposed to global commodity and domestic price volatility, and the MD&A risk table adds that fluctuations in global pulp and wastepaper prices may impact input costs and margins. Mitigation is a diversified sourcing strategy across geographies and suppliers, long-term arrangements, term contracts with selective spot purchases, inventory planning and selective hedging.
risks.risk: Raw material availability and price volatility (pulp, wastepaper, chemicals)

risks.note: USD-linked imports create a mismatch against INR revenues; rupee depreciation increases landed input cost. This is amplified by the quality-led model built on imported virgin wood pulp and imported machinery, against exports of only about 5% of turnover, so there is little natural offset. Mitigation is hedging through forward contracts and other approved instruments under the treasury policy, plus natural hedging mechanisms.

Compliance with effluent, EPR, ZLD and environmental norms requires continuous investment, and the Company is subject to evolving environmental laws which may impact operations. Mitigation is a dedicated compliance team, internal audit review and management systems aligned with relevant certifications, supported by continuous monitoring and process upgrades.

Water is a critical input for paper manufacturing, and scarcity, cost escalation or regulatory restrictions can affect operations, production stability and compliance. Mitigation is improved water recycling and reuse, optimised process water consumption, strengthened rainwater harvesting and development of multiple water sources.

Digital media, e-governance and online education reduce long-term demand for W&P grades, and the shift to digital media consumption may reduce demand for newsprint over time. This bears directly on the segments where the Company holds its stated leadership (premium newsprint) and its Solitaire brand presence. Mitigation is a progressive rebalancing of the product mix toward packaging board and specialty papers to reduce dependence on newsprint.
risks.risk: Digital substitution in writing and printing paper and newsprint

risks.note: Energy costs constitute a significant portion of operating expenses and are subject to volatility, while sub-optimal utilisation of manufacturing capacity may affect operating efficiency and profitability. Mitigation is captive power generation, proximity to coal sources, ongoing energy-efficiency initiatives and evaluation of alternate energy sources, together with a diversified product portfolio and flexible production planning to optimise utilisation.

Digital manufacturing systems and ERP platforms (the Company maintains all records in SAP with workflow and approvals routed through it) increase exposure to cyber threats and operational disruption. Mitigation is IT security controls, role-based access, firewalls, endpoint protection, a comprehensive security policy and periodic audits.
risks.risk: Cybersecurity risk across digital manufacturing and ERP systems
